registration.description: Adult female cartoon voice actress performing a bossy know-it-all playground girl for an adult animated horror-comedy. Exaggerated high, sharp, shrill and slightly squeaky nasal tone with a smug sing-song lilt and deadpan sarcastic punchlines, in the spirit of crude adult TV cartoons. Fast confident delivery. Native Slovak speaker, precise articulation, every word understandable. Clearly different from a raspy brat and a timid wobbly voice. Clean dry studio recording, no music or background.
